journey.title: Tab out of the visit date into the access notes
journey.goal: Pressing Tab in the open date field moves focus to the next form field so the user can keep typing

functionalJourney.title: Pick a visit date with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the visit date field

guards.title: Pick the next day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys move the calendar focus and Enter commits the date

plan.root_cause: The datepicker popup element is focusable and intercepts the Tab key, trapping focus inside the datepicker and preventing focus from moving to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Make the datepicker element non-focusable by setting tabindex="-1", allowing the Tab key to bypass the popup and move focus to the next focusable element.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When the datepicker is open, pressing Tab will move focus from the visit date input to the next form field (the access notes input), allowing keyboard-only users to continue filling the form without being trapped.
functional_risks: None significant; datepicker remains operable via arrow keys, Enter, and mouse interactions.
Setting tabindex=-1 removes the popup from the tab order, which is appropriate for a modal-like dialog and does not affect screen reader perception of the datepicker's content.
verification_requirements: Pressing Tab while the datepicker is open moves focus to the #notes input.
Arrow keys still navigate dates within the datepicker.
Enter key still selects the focused date and closes the datepicker.
Datepicker still opens on focus or click of the visit date input.
Datepicker still hides appropriately when a date is selected or when clicking outside.

plan.root_cause: The datepicker popup contains focusable button elements (prev, viewSwitch, next, today, clear) that intercept Tab key navigation, preventing focus from moving to the next form field (#notes). Although the popup container has tabindex=-1, the internal buttons remain in the tab order.
plan.repair_strategy: Set tabindex=-1 on the datepicker container and all its button controls to remove them from the tab order, allowing Tab to bypass the popup entirely and move focus to the next form field.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When the datepicker is open, pressing Tab moves focus from the visit date input to the next form field (access notes), allowing keyboard-only users to continue filling the form without being trapped in the datepicker.
functional_risks: Datepicker buttons become unreachable via keyboard (but they are mouse-only controls; keyboard users navigate dates via arrow keys on the input).
No significant risk; datepicker remains operable via arrow keys, Enter, Escape, and mouse interactions.
verification_requirements: Pressing Tab while the datepicker is open moves focus to the #notes input.
Arrow keys still navigate dates within the datepicker.
Enter key still selects the focused date and closes the datepicker.
Datepicker still opens on focus or click of the visit date input.
Datepicker still hides appropriately when a date is selected or when clicking outside.
